name: Big Ten Cross Country Championships
where: Verona, WI · host Wisconsin · Zimmer XC Course
headline: Big Ten Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Oregon swept the team titles. The No. 6 Ducks men scored 23 points to beat No. 14 Wisconsin (62) and Michigan State (90), with Oregon's Simeon Birnbaum winning the 8K in 23:04.2. In the women's race Oregon scored 35 to Northwestern's 90 and Penn State's 92, and Diana Cherotich won in 18:56.1.
